Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Siya - 11 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Sunita - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan hugs Mother tightly.]

Ishaan: "Let's see."

[Ishaan shakes his head.]

Ishaan: "That's great!"

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look at this."

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Ishaan: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's begin."

[Ishaan knocks on the door.]

Sunita: "That was fun!"

[Ishaan opens the door and goes out.]

Sunita: "How beautiful!"

[Ishaan slams the door shut.]

Ishaan (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Ishaan opens the window.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

Scene 3: The park - Day

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan goes down the slide.]

Sunita: "Exactly right."

[Siya skips rope.]

Sunita (gently): "I really enjoyed today."
